name: hw-apex-bench
description: hw-apex-bench is an adapter-based benchmark for lossless compression and random access to compressed data.Version 0.1 supports four formats: BGZF, zstd-seekable, ACEAPEX and blocked XZ. The harness covers nine measurement axes: compression ratio, encoding throughput, full decoding throughput, regional latency (p50/p99), decoding amplification, granularity cost c(g), batch access throughput, access entropy and break-even request count. Unsupported measurements carry explicit reasons.Adapters provide capability declarations and byte-exact qualification. Regional measurements use native library paths with resident archives and explicit timing boundaries. Results retain configuration, commands, provenance and verification information.The original 435 published measurement records are preserved byte for byte. A separate full native run produced 236 records: 98 of 101 deterministic comparisons matched initially; the three BGZF differences were subsequently resolved by an untimed libdeflate build audit. Timing values are host-dependent and are not claimed to match byte for byte.The full comparison covers the original three CPU formats and four configurations. XZ has separate correctness and small-corpus nine-axis evidence; it is not presented as a full-corpus historical performance result.
